text: Once a year, Timur runs a drill he calls the worst day.
prefix: Once a year, Timur runs a drill he calls the worst day.

text: He hands a colleague a full copy of the card zone's database and says: get me one card number out of this.
prefix: He hands a colleague a full copy of the card zone's database and says: get me one card number out of this.

text: If the table held plain card numbers, the drill would take a second.
prefix: If the table held plain card numbers, the drill would take a second.

text: If it held numbers locked with a key kept right next to them, it would take two.
prefix: If it held numbers locked with a key kept right next to them, it would take two.

text: Most teams stop at that second version, and I think it is the most dangerous kind of safety, because it looks finished.
prefix: Most teams stop at that second version, and I think it is the most dangerous kind of safety, because it looks finished.

text: The key must never sit next to the data.
prefix: The key must never sit next to the data.

text: In Lesson 6, Vault came in to hold every key, so no key is ever typed into a file.
prefix: In Lesson 6, Vault came in to hold every key, so no key is ever typed into a file.

text: This lesson gives Vault a second job: sealing card numbers.
prefix: This lesson gives Vault a second job: sealing card numbers.

text: When Malika's buyer types a card, the card vault, the service that keeps cards, hands the number to Vault.
prefix: When Malika's buyer types a card, the card vault, the service that keeps cards, hands the number to Vault.

text: Vault hands back a sealed value.
prefix: Vault hands back a sealed value.

text: The card vault keeps only that sealed value.
prefix: The card vault keeps only that sealed value.

text: The key never leaves Vault.
prefix: The key never leaves Vault.

text: Each seal is tied to its own card.
prefix: Each seal is tied to its own card.

text: A sealed value copied into another card's place will not open.
prefix: A sealed value copied into another card's place will not open.

text: So nobody can shuffle values around to trick the system.
prefix: So nobody can shuffle values around to trick the system.

text: Then a puzzle.
prefix: Then a puzzle.

text: Sometimes the card zone must find a card again by its number.
prefix: Sometimes the card zone must find a card again by its number.

text: It must do that without opening every seal.
prefix: It must do that without opening every seal.

text: So Vault also stamps each number with a fingerprint.
prefix: So Vault also stamps each number with a fingerprint.

text: The same number always gives the same fingerprint.
prefix: The same number always gives the same fingerprint.

text: The fingerprint cannot be turned back into the number.
prefix: The fingerprint cannot be turned back into the number.

text: This stamp is called a blind index.
prefix: This stamp is called a blind index.

text: The card zone looks up the fingerprint, never the number.
prefix: The card zone looks up the fingerprint, never the number.

text: The database guards its own door too.
prefix: The database guards its own door too.

text: It refuses any card value that is not sealed.
prefix: It refuses any card value that is not sealed.

text: Even a mistake in the code cannot write a plain number into it.
prefix: Even a mistake in the code cannot write a plain number into it.

text: What if Vault is down?
prefix: What if Vault is down?

text: Then the card vault stops.
prefix: Then the card vault stops.

text: It never guesses, and it never falls back to keeping a plain number.
prefix: It never guesses, and it never falls back to keeping a plain number.

text: Stopping safely instead of carrying on unsafely is called fail closed.
prefix: Stopping safely instead of carrying on unsafely is called fail closed.

text: A number is opened for one reason only: to hand it to the card's network for a charge.
prefix: A number is opened for one reason only: to hand it to the card's network for a charge.

text: Every use of card data is written down: what happened, who asked, and when.
prefix: Every use of card data is written down: what happened, who asked, and when.

text: And a card nobody has used for the bank's chosen time is removed.
prefix: And a card nobody has used for the bank's chosen time is removed.

text: Only a short note keeps its token and its masked number.
prefix: Only a short note keeps its token and its masked number.

text: Malika's buyer sees none of this.
prefix: Malika's buyer sees none of this.

text: The buyer types a card into the card form and confirms the code.
prefix: The buyer types a card into the card form and confirms the code.

text: The form says "Card accepted" and empties its number field.

text: The payment page then shows one line: the first six digits, a row of stars, and the last four.
prefix: The payment page then shows one line: the first six digits, a row of stars, and the last four.

text: Beside them sit the card's network and the bank that issued it.

text: A buyer types a card, and the form refuses it with a short message.
